peertube_partial_review.scope: Selected package exports/dependencies, shared API interfaces, TS references/options, controller imports, OpenAPI link middleware and spec header, ci lint/spec-validation and command wrapper. No full-file sign-off or complete dependency graph.
limitations: Uses barrels/controllers-to-model too; no proof cycle free
Base strict=false/noImplicitAny=false, versus Polutek strict=true declaration; enforcement needs actual checks
openapiOperationDoc sets docs URL, does not validate response body
Command generic response types do not establish runtime schema validation
Separate OpenAPI/models/validators can drift; no round-trip validation executed
